story.title: The Silence Tax
story.logline: A man discovers that every kind word he speaks subtracts money from his bank account, forcing him to choose between his wealth and his kindness.
story.twist: The bank account is actually fueled by the silent hatred he harbors toward everyone around him.
story.ending: How much is your kindness worth when the balance finally hits zero?

scenes.narration: My bank account drops fifty dollars every single time I tell a stranger to have a wonderful day.
scenes.visual_prompt: Leo, 28, messy brown hair, wearing a worn green hoodie, staring at his glowing smartphone screen in a dim, crowded coffee shop.
scenes.camera: Extreme close-up on the phone screen showing a dropping balance.

scenes.narration: Kindness is an expensive luxury in this city, draining my savings account faster than rent ever could.
scenes.visual_prompt: Leo, 28, messy brown hair, wearing a worn green hoodie, looking up from his phone with wide, panicked eyes inside the crowded coffee shop.
scenes.camera: Medium shot tracking Leo's anxious face.

scenes.narration: Yesterday I praised my coworker's new haircut, and my checking balance vanished entirely into thin air.
scenes.visual_prompt: Leo, 28, messy brown hair, wearing a worn green hoodie, standing by a sleek office desk, gripping his head in disbelief.
scenes.camera: Over-the-shoulder shot focusing on the empty bank app.

scenes.narration: So today I decided to stay completely silent, watching the world crumble around me without a single word.
scenes.visual_prompt: Leo, 28, messy brown hair, wearing a worn green hoodie, sitting rigidly on a busy subway train, refusing to help a fallen passenger.
scenes.camera: Push-in medium shot on Leo's cold, blank expression.

scenes.narration: To my complete astonishment, the silence made my bank app ping with massive, unearned cash deposits.
scenes.visual_prompt: Leo, 28, messy brown hair, wearing a worn green hoodie, staring down at his phone as a green counter spins upward rapidly on the subway.
scenes.camera: Close-up on the green numbers rapidly climbing.

scenes.narration: Every cold glare I throw at a crying child adds hundreds of dollars straight to my wallet.
scenes.visual_prompt: Leo, 28, messy brown hair, wearing a worn green hoodie, glaring harshly at a toddler on the subway car, watching his phone tick upward.
scenes.camera: Low angle tracking shot looking up at Leo's smug face.

scenes.narration: I am getting richer by the minute simply by hating everyone who crosses my path today.
scenes.visual_prompt: Leo, 28, messy brown hair, wearing a worn green hoodie, walking down a sunny city sidewalk, shoving past an elderly woman.
scenes.camera: Tracking shot moving backward in front of Leo.

scenes.narration: Then the app flashed a terrifying alert revealing the horrific truth behind my sudden financial success.
scenes.visual_prompt: Leo, 28, messy brown hair, wearing a worn green hoodie, stopping dead on the sidewalk, reading a terrifying red pop-up notification.
scenes.camera: Extreme close-up on Leo's terrified eyes reflecting red light.

scenes.narration: The money was never mine to begin with; it was the stolen life force of people I ignored.
scenes.visual_prompt: Leo, 28, messy brown hair, wearing a worn green hoodie, watching people around him fade into transparent, gray ghosts on the street.
scenes.camera: Wide establishing shot with a surreal visual effect.

scenes.narration: Now my pockets overflow with gold, while my soul remains completely, irreversibly, and terrifyingly bankrupt.
scenes.visual_prompt: Leo, 28, messy brown hair, wearing a worn green hoodie, standing alone in a totally empty, dark city street, holding glowing hands.
scenes.camera: Static wide shot looking down at a lonely figure.

caption.hook: Kindness is officially the most expensive luxury.
caption.title: The Silence Tax
caption.caption: Arthur learned that every time he whispered a compliment, his balance plummeted. But staying rich meant swallowing his venom—until he realized what the bank was actually living on. Would you go broke to be good?
